dict.string: Sense reads Music or Spotify artwork and controls their playback when you enable Now Playing.
Sense captures window thumbnails for the switcher and a temporary desktop image for the optional lid-closing fold effect.
Sense reads your calendar on this Mac to show your next event in the island. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
